notes.title: Changing Course
notes.content:
Hello again,
This is Finger tip, the developer.

Let me get straight to the point without any long introduction:
I’ve decided to shift the direction of Ocean Explorer in order to make it a more unique experience.
As a result, the release date is currently undecided.

Ocean Explorer was originally inspired by the classic game Uncharted Waters II.
However, during development, I saw the release of several excellent games with similar goals.
To make Ocean Explorer stand out, I’ve chosen to refine its core strength—exploring the world map by ship.

What will not change is the central concept: traveling the world by sea.

Here is our updated direction:
I aim to make the game easier to understand by giving players a clear purpose.

[list]
[*] You play as the captain of a cruise ship, entrusted by a travel agency to journey around the world.
[*] As your reputation grows and your ship is upgraded, you’ll unlock new destinations and increase your profits.
[*] Trade and monster encounters will be scaled back or reworked to better fit the new vision.
[/list]

That’s all for now.
It may take some time, but I’m committed to creating an experience that will delight those who love travel and world maps.
Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Version 0.1.8 of the demo has been released!
notes.content:
Version 0.1.8 of the demo has been released!

[b]Update Details[/b]
[list]
[*] Added BGM to the port area.
[*] Improved acceleration effect for ships.
[*] Increased the range of cannons.
[*] Increased the power of cannons.
[*] Shortened the range of rifles.
[*] Made rifles capable of longer continuous fire.
[/list]

Although there haven’t been updates for a while, I plan to increase the update frequency to show more progress going forward.
Thank you for your continued support of Ocean Explorer!

notes.title: The development of Ocean Explorer is starting up again.
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience.

We’re planning to resume development and will begin addressing the feedback we've received. We'll focus on selecting actionable feedback to improve Ocean Explorer.

The demo will be made playable again soon. Although some issues remain, we’re prioritizing getting Ocean Explorer out to a wider audience.

Thank you for your continued support of Ocean Explorer.

notes.title: The demo is no longer available following the end of NEXT Fest.
notes.content:
NEXT Fest has ended.
I hope you enjoyed Ocean Explorer!

Thank you for your feedback and bug reports.
To address these issues, I stop the demo's availability.

I plan to re-release the demo after making improvements.
Thank you for playing.

Please install the latest version.

notes.title: The DEMO is now live!
notes.content:
The demo is now live! (For the second time…)

Good and bad things happen, but we’ve made changes over time to improve it little by little.
I love the retro game map navigation, and I’ve packed the joy of discovery on the map.
Please play the demo. I hope you enjoy it.

In the demo, you can explore the Mediterranean area.
Gibraltar is blocked, but in the full version, you can travel around the world.

[b]Any feedback is welcome.[/b]
I’ll try to read it as much as possible on the forums and social media.

Enjoy exploring the Nile River!
